content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** The § 2(a) Interface licence to Client fails both fallback elements — no affiliate coverage (and § 8(c) restricts access to Client's own personnel), and § 15 allows transfer only with TrueLink's approval, with an affiliate-only exception rather than an M&A successor right. I proposed a fallback-level cure: a new § 2(e) extending the licence to affiliates on written notice and allowing transfer to a successor in a merger or acquisition without TrueLink's approval, plus a minimal conforming edit to § 8(c) so licensed affiliates' personnel may access the Interface. I deliberately did not widen the mutual assignment exception in § 15 (which would benefit TrueLink) and did not pursue the preferred perpetual/irrevocable points, which do not fit this term-limited licence.
